APPROVED 2026-08-25. The implementation plan lives in the Description of ADO #181, ready to hand to a new session.

Everything below is a decision, not a question.

DECIDED — live mode is the pinned red item and nothing else.

The floating button, the app-bar button and the PWA home-screen shortcut were all considered and rejected. Two taps from anywhere (hamburger, then the red bar) is accepted.

OPEN, BUT NOT HERE — a Logistics Coordinator gets a 4-entry menu: no My Availability (no SUBMIT_AVAILABILITY) and no My Reports (no CREATE_EVENT_REPORT).

That is what ROLE_PERMISSIONS says today and the menu is right to reflect it. Whether every role should be able to declare availability is a permissions decision, not a navigation one — it needs its own work item. The plan explicitly forbids papering over it by making those entries unconditional.

DECIDED — ONE entry, "Personnel", under PEOPLE, route /users, gated by VIEW_USERS.

The screen already varies its fields by capability, so an admin editing an email and a coordinator editing certifications share one list. The Personnel/User Accounts split was rejected. This settles #163's provisional placement.

DECIDED — the live-runs oversight board gets its own screen at /live-runs under OPERATIONS, gated by VIEW_LIVE_RUNS. It stays on the Dashboard as well.

LiveRunBoard needs one new optional prop (emptyState) so the standalone screen is not a blank page when nothing is running; the Dashboard passes nothing and behaves exactly as it does today.

DEFERRED TO #180 — that story makes the whole app bilingual, so this one does not touch language.

Labels stay English typed inline, per the convention in i18n/labels.ts, with "Emergência" the one exception. The manifest holds a plain label string so #180 can swap it for a key in one file.
OUT OF SCOPE — the two count badges (12 unreviewed reports, 3 certification alerts) are drawn to show where badges would sit. They are not part of #181 and need their own work item.
